notes: Fix: SOAP body was assembled into a 600-byte buffer, leaving 311 bytes for parameters after envelope overhead. Short calls always fit; setURI() does not -- a Sonos favorite's DIDL-Lite metadata was silently truncated into malformed XML, so play_uri gestures and auto-resume failed against real cloud content while working fine with a bare stream URL. Body is now a String. Also reports spkIp/spkPort to the fleet hub so the dashboard can distinguish a multi's zones, which all share one IP.
